scripts.check: npm run frontend:check && npm run integration:test && npm run worker:test
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.pages:build:staging: VITE_APP_ENV=staging VITE_API_URL=https://e-posyandu-api-staging.eposyandu-puskesmas-gumukmas.workers.dev npm --prefix frontend run build -- --mode staging
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run pages:build && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name e-posyandu --branch main
scripts.pages:deploy:staging: npm run pages:build:staging && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name e-posyandu-staging --branch staging
